changelog:
Initial release of Hermes Agent backup & restore skill.

- Provides portable backup and restore scripts for Hermes Agent data.
- Backs up configs, secrets, profiles, skills, sessions, cron, and more, using consistent SQLite snapshots.
- Generates portable tar.gz archives with a JSON manifest and integrity verification.
- Includes options for full backups, profile selection, dry-run previews, and merging on restore.
- Safety features: autochecks running gateway before restore, permission hardening post-restore.
- Excludes code, caches, logs, and runtime files.
summary: Back up and restore Hermes Agent data — config, secrets, skills, sessions, memories, cron, profiles. Creates portable tar.gz archives with SQLite consistent snapshots, JSON manifest, and integrity verification. Use when: "back up hermes", "restore hermes", "migrate hermes to new machine", "hermes backup", "hermes restore", "hermes 数据备份", "hermes 数据恢复".
